scope: Small 3x20-line TypeScript workload only. Three same-build A/A pairs interleaved with three parent/current pairs, alternating side order. Five post-diagnostic-renderer-GC samples in each fresh Linux Electron process. Same current core/dependencies. Signed paired differences and difference-of-medians are descriptive, not confidence intervals, significance tests, peak limits or proof of equivalence. No concurrent tests/benchmarks.
